description: The RCF review surface offers a Product Map tab in addition to Overview, Requirements, Architecture and Build sequence. The tab lets a product reader group requirements by shape, status, component (TAC), trace coverage or capability. Every grouping drills group -> requirement (with a status pill) -> its user stories -> acceptance criteria. Groupings and the status filter are hash-addressable so a URL of the form #tab=product-map&group=capability&status=approved is deep-linkable and shareable.
title: Product Map tab on the review surface
rationale: The Requirements tab is a flat REQ list ordered by id. A product reader (operator or reviewer) does not think in that shape - they think in surfaces, capabilities, states, and what has and has not been built yet. The Product Map tab re-buckets the same in-memory tree by the axes the data actually populates (shape 65%, status 100%) and by two derived axes (component-first via TAC, and trace coverage), plus a convention-driven capability grouping. No schema change; all work is a re-bucketing of the tree-model the view already builds.
